item.text: {"diagnoses":[{"preserve":"The guide introduces discovering security risks and vulnerabilities within a few minutes; retain the timing as an estimate rather than a guarantee.","problem":"“Most critical” promises a level of prioritization this introductory sentence does not establish, while “only” adds promotional emphasis to the timing.","quote":"Discover your most critical security risks and vulnerabilities in only a few minutes.","segment_index":0,"unit_ordinal":25},{"preserve":"Keep the preceding overview of installation, scanning a local project, and viewing results.","problem":"This exhortation repeats the Getting started heading and delays the installation instructions without adding guidance.","quote":"Let's get started!","segment_index":0,"unit_ordinal":27},{"preserve":"The install script automatically selects a build for the user's architecture; preserve the separate installation-directory and latest-release defaults.","problem":"“Quickest” asserts an unsubstantiated comparison with the other installation methods, and “best build” obscures the concrete architecture-selection behavior with an evaluative adjective.","quote":"The quickest way to install Bearer CLI is with the install script. It will auto-select the best build for your architecture.","segment_index":0,"unit_ordinal":29},{"preserve":"After completion, the default output is a security report containing rule findings, their code locations, and explanations.","problem":"The sentence first promises “details of any rule findings” and then loosely appends the actual details with “as well as.” Switching from “findings” to “infractions” also makes one report concept sound like two.","quote":"Once the scan is complete, Bearer CLI will output, by default, a security report with details of any rule findings, as well as where in the codebase the infractions happened and why.","segment_index":0,"unit_ordinal":56},{"preserve":"The security report presents issues detected by Bearer CLI; retain the following list of report contents.","problem":"“Easily digestible” is subjective praise where the following list already explains the report's organization concretely.","quote":"The security report is an easily digestible view of the security issues detected by Bearer CLI.","segment_index":0,"unit_ordinal":60},{"preserve":"Keep the pointer to additional scan usage and configuration options.","problem":"The rhetorical question adds an empty transition before a useful documentation pointer.","quote":"Ready for the next step?","segment_index":0,"unit_ordinal":68},{"preserve":"SAST output can include hundreds of issues with limited context or prioritization and often requires manual analyst triage.","problem":"“Are known to bury” substitutes an appeal to reputation and a loaded metaphor for the actual triage problem. “No sense of priority” also presents a sweeping characterization without support on the page.","quote":"SAST tools are known to bury security teams and developers under hundreds of issues with little context and no sense of priority, often requiring security analysts to triage issues manually.","segment_index":0,"unit_ordinal":73},{"preserve":"Bearer starts with sensitive data and prioritizes findings by assessing sensitive data flows; retain the linked support for prioritization.","problem":"“The most vulnerable asset today” introduces an unsupported universal ranking and time-sensitive assertion that are unnecessary to explain Bearer's focus.","quote":"The most vulnerable asset today is sensitive data, so we start there and","segment_index":0,"unit_ordinal":74},{"preserve":"The sensitive-data-flow capability also enables a privacy scanner.","problem":"“Unique” claims exclusivity without comparative support; the useful point is the connection between data-flow analysis and privacy scanning.","quote":"This unique ability allows us to provide you with a privacy scanner too.","segment_index":0,"unit_ordinal":75},{"preserve":"Retain the authors' belief that connecting security issues to business impact and breach or leak risk can improve software at no extra cost; do not turn that belief into a guarantee.","problem":"“Better and more robust software” gives two broad evaluations without identifying the intended improvement, and the long belief-and-capability framing buries the concrete link to business risk.","quote":"We believe that by linking security issues with a clear business impact and risk of a data breach, or data leak, we can build better and more robust software, at no extra cost.","segment_index":0,"unit_ordinal":76},{"preserve":"Bearer is described as free, open, extensible by design, and designed with developer experience in mind.","problem":"“Great developer UX” and “we bet you will see the difference for yourself” replace an explanation of the differentiator with praise and an unverifiable prediction about the reader.","quote":"In addition, by being Free and Open, extendable by design, and built with a great developer UX in mind, we bet you will see the difference for yourself.","segment_index":0,"unit_ordinal":77},{"preserve":"Bearer examines source code only and cannot view actual data values.","problem":"“Most importantly” imposes an unnecessary importance ranking, and the interrupting “it just can’t” repeats the limitation emphatically instead of explaining it.","quote":"Most importantly, it never views the actual values—it just can’t—but only the code itself.","segment_index":0,"unit_ordinal":82},{"preserve":"Bearer identifies more than 120 data types; retain all named sensitive-data categories and their abbreviations.","problem":"“Over” and “+” redundantly express the same lower-bound qualification on 120.","quote":"Bearer CLI is able to identify over 120+ data types","segment_index":0,"unit_ordinal":84},{"preserve":"Scanning time depends on application size and can range from 20 seconds to a few minutes for a large codebase.","problem":"“Extremely large” has no defined scale, making the timing estimate difficult to interpret; “extremely” adds emphasis without making the workload condition more precise.","quote":"It can take as little as 20 seconds, up to a few minutes for an extremely large code base.","segment_index":0,"unit_ordinal":92},{"preserve":"False positives remain possible with SAST tools.","problem":"The introductory condition concerns the reader's familiarity, although the possibility of false positives does not depend on that familiarity.","quote":"If you’re familiar with SAST tools, false positives are always a possibility.","segment_index":0,"unit_ordinal":97},{"preserve":"Bearer uses static code analysis and native filtering and prioritization of important issues; retain the authors' belief in improvement without implying that false positives are eliminated.","problem":"“Most modern” and “dramatically improved” assert superiority and magnitude without evidence here. “Overall SAST experience” is too broad to answer the specific false-positive question.","quote":"By using the most modern static code analysis techniques and providing a native filtering and prioritizing solution on the most important issues, we believe we have dramatically improved the overall SAST experience.","segment_index":0,"unit_ordinal":98},{"preserve":"Keep the following link to the explanation of how language support is evaluated.","problem":"This generic aspiration adds no information about false positives and repeats the preceding claim about improving the SAST experience.","quote":"We strive to provide the best possible experience for our users.","segment_index":0,"unit_ordinal":99},{"preserve":"CD integration is possible, but the recommendation is to fail only on high-criticality issues because of potential organizational impact.","problem":"“The impact for your organization might be important” leaves both the affected activity and the nature of the impact unclear, weakening the rationale for the failure threshold.","quote":"You can also integrate Bearer CLI in your CD, though we recommend setting it to only fail on high criticality issues, as the impact for your organization might be important.","segment_index":0,"unit_ordinal":103},{"preserve":"Cross-function and cross-file analysis helps identify vulnerabilities involving interactions between components and reduces false positives compared with analysis limited to individual functions or files. Retain the separate Java benchmark evidence.","problem":"“Crucial” asserts necessity and “significantly” asserts an unspecified reduction. The subsequent benchmark reports Java results but supplies no comparison establishing that reduction's magnitude.","quote":"This is crucial for accurately identifying complex vulnerabilities that depend on the interaction of different code components, significantly reducing false positives compared to analyses limited to individual functions or files.","segment_index":0,"unit_ordinal":109},{"preserve":"Bearer Pro's interprocedural and inter-file analysis for Java scored 76% on the OWASP Java Benchmark, with a reported false positive rate below 2%.","problem":"“Demonstrated strong results” adds an undefined assessment before the precise benchmark figures that readers can evaluate directly.","quote":"Bearer Pro's interprocedural and inter-file analysis for Java has demonstrated strong results on the OWASP Java Benchmark, achieving a score of 76% with a reported false positive rate of less than 2%.","segment_index":0,"unit_ordinal":110}],"page_id":"Bearer/bearer/README.md","source_sha256":"1b2b49d29eb7ce3e34dfe6562269878ffce3ed8aef947edacbe90764274f0fc7"}
